verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, since transcription services commonly offer completion callbacks. However, the evidence only documents synchronous upload-and-receive transcription, streaming text, a CLI, and a local Python library. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
